summary.en: A line runs round one element and names it; when it closes the content arrives inside and the line becomes the element's edge.
summary.zh: 一条线沿元素轮廓跑一圈把它点名，闭合时内容进场，线交棒成元素自己的边。

fits: Naming one card, chart, panel or frame before its content is read: the first appearance of a key result, one cell of a wall lighting up, a frame closing round a page.
notFor: Several elements at once (the eye follows one line); elements without a clear rectangular edge; styles whose lines must stay still.

overlaps.note: redraws a reading path in phosphor; outline-trace draws one element's edge
four corners lock on a target; outline-trace runs the whole outline
a marker line under words (typography batch); draw-svg-trace's underline goes there

intent.en: Point at one element before its content is read: a line drawn in front of the eye picks it out, and the content arriving as the line closes says 'this is what we talk about next'.
intent.zh: 在内容被读之前先点名一个元素：一条当场画出的线把它圈出来，线闭合时内容进场，等于说“接下来讲它”。

content.en: One element with a clear rectangular or rounded edge (a card, a chart, a panel, a page frame) whose content blocks fade in after the close; the brick has no text of its own.
content.zh: 一个有清楚矩形或圆角边的元素（卡片、图表、面板、页框），它的内容块在线闭合后进场；积木本身不带文字。

fits.zh: 内容被读之前先点名一张卡、一张图表、一个面板或一个页框：关键结果第一次露面、墙上某一格亮起、一个框合拢圈住一页。

notFor.zh: 同时点名几个元素（眼睛只跟得住一条线）；没有清楚矩形边的元素；线条必须静止的风格。

pairs.note: the comet head lights each cell of the wall
the split head is the frame that runs ahead of the page

en: Outline one element per call-out; several outlines queued on one screen read as a loading animation.
The line's path must match the element's real corner radius, or the hand-over to its edge visibly jumps.
Do not fade the content in before the line closes; the cause, drawn then filled, breaks.
Use one whole-wall outline light-up per film (this or a blueprint wireframe draw, not both).
zh: 一次只点名一个元素；同屏排队各画一圈读作加载动画。
描边路径的圆角必须和元素真实圆角一致，否则交棒成边的瞬间错型穿帮。
内容别抢在线闭合之前出来，“先画再填”的因果会断。
一支片整墙描边点亮只用一次（本积木或蓝图描线二选一）。

upstream.name: SVG 描线追踪
upstream.summary: 描边生长圈注——一条带笔头的墨线沿元素轮廓跑一圈把它"画"出来，闭合瞬间闪黑交棒、内容淡入；同套路可给标题画下划线
upstream.use: 单个卡片/图表/标题的被点名入场；元素级手法（整页级蓝图描线归 wall-reveal-moves B 式）

upstream.name: 逐格点亮
upstream.summary: 暗场 3×2 bento 墙压暗待命，琥珀流光逐格描边一圈、内容随即提亮上浮，全亮后镜头缓推收住
upstream.use: 功能墙/卡片墙/整页界面的整体亮相；内容已在原位、要"显形"而非"涌入"的段落

upstream.name: 霓虹框先行
upstream.summary: 强透视直角霓虹框自左缘两头奔画先行成型，页面在框内由暗转亮，同时框内组件/文字从 3D 上空带同形软影错峰贴落、随页面点亮同步完成贴合，背景霓虹群（demo 为同形框纵深回声隧道）终段熄灭让位
upstream.use: 暗场品牌片里给 UI 面板做"登场仪式"（框先到、内容后落）；功能区首次亮相；霓虹/赛博调性的段落开场
upstream.energy: 中高（三层动作叠进，但都服务同一次登场）
